title: Buffer/overlay: schools within a mile (live OpenStreetMap)
query: How many schools does OpenStreetMap have within 1 mile of 41.9231 N, 87.7093 W?

expected_why.count_within_mile: Overpass https://overpass.kumi.systems/api/interpreter at run time, nwr amenity=school

answer:
OpenStreetMap has **19 schools within 1 mile** of **41.9231° N, 87.7093° W**.

This count comes from live OSM features tagged `amenity=school`, using straight-line distance. It includes public, private, religious, and unnamed mapped schools; OSM coverage may be incomplete or outdated.
